disclosures.problem: .NET Remote Code Execution Vulnerability
description: The Blazor WebAssembly debug proxy embeds attacker-controlled ToString(), description, and class-name values into generated C# without consistently escaping them. When a developer evaluates an expression while debugging, the value can escape the generated string literal and execute code on the developer's machine.

description: A buffer overflow vulnerability exists in .NET's use of the Brotli decompression algorithm. This vulnerability may allow an unauthenticated attacker to read or corrupt process memory. This could lead to information disclosure, denial of service, or elevation of privilege.
An out-of-bounds write vulnerability exists in the Brotli decoder used by .NET.

disclosures.problem: .NET Elevation of Privilege Vulnerability
description: Microsoft is releasing this security advisory to provide information about a vulnerability in file ownership in Linux .NET tarball distributions, including ASP.NET Core runtime tarballs, ASP.NET Core Targeting Pack tarballs, and source-built .NET tarballs.
Incorrect ownership of runtime files installed from affected Linux tarballs can allow local elevation of privilege.
